summary.headline: Medical Astrology and Hermetic Canons
summary.text: Catalogue of Florentine codex folios 1–23, listing Hermou’s iatromathematika to Ammon, medical astrology on surgery and diseases under the Moon in each zodiac sign, eclipses, Pancharios’ epitome, and canons attributed to Hermes Trismegistus and Petosiris. It also records Katarchai kata Zenarion and numerical divinations concerning illness by weekdays, tetrads, and lunar calculations, with references to Ideler, Kühn, codex 7, and a Paris manuscript.
